note: Forbidden: a further Configure-Request carrying the interface-identifier option after a valid Interface-Identifier Configure-Reject. TestIPv6CPInterfaceIDRejectIsFatal fails when no EventSessionDown follows the Reject (absorbIPv6CPReject returns ncpReplyFatal, so no new CR is ever sent); a regression that absorbs and resends keeps the session up and goes red. Negative TestIPv6CPUnknownOptionRejectNotFatal fails if a Reject of an unrequested option stops negotiation.
